intro: Morgan Pestle is a human alchemist and shopkeeper who runs Pestle's Apothecary in the Trade District of Stormwind City. Working closely with his brother William Pestle in Goldshire, he handles supplies and alchemical research for the capital.

p: Operating out of Pestle's Apothecary along the busy thoroughfares of Stormwind's Trade District, Morgan Pestle provides alchemical goods, reagents, and practical remedies to city residents and passing travelers. While his brother William maintains a workshop at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Morgan keeps the family trade rooted in the heart of the kingdom's capital, managing shipments of herbs and compounds back and forth from the rural heartlands.
